en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Love song with a traditional-style closing couplet; origin unclear, I cannot name an author. 'браној' is read as 'бранови' (waves), 'нејќит' and 'земит' are dialect forms, my reading.

lines.cyr: Пред да си умрам, сакам да кажам
lines.lat: Pred da si umram, sakam da kažam
lines.en: Before I die, I want to tell
of our sincere love.
Oh, alas, my love, my little seagull,
you have burned my heart.

lines.cyr: Помниш ли мила, помниш ли драга,
lines.lat: Pomniš li mila, pomniš li draga,
lines.en: Do you remember, dear, do you remember, darling,
when we two loved each other?
You gave me your hand,
with true, sincere love.

lines.cyr: Дење и ноќе плачев за тебе
lines.lat: Denje i noḱe plačev za tebe
lines.en: Day and night I cried for you,
most of all for love.
Oh, alas, my love, my little seagull,
you have burned my heart.
In the night when the moon shone,
and rays fell upon you,
in tender embraces we two
on clean sand by the lake,

lines.cyr: а ти трепериш, ах мила моја
lines.lat: a ti treperiš, ah mila moja
lines.en: and you trembled, ah my dear,
and listened to the sound of the waves.

lines.cyr: Тоа не се браној, тоа се песни
lines.lat: Toa ne se branoj, toa se pesni
lines.en: Those are not waves, those are songs
that sing only of love.

lines.cyr: Кој што се нејќит да се не земит,
lines.lat: Koj što se nejḱit da se ne zemit,
lines.en: Whoever is unwilling to marry, let them not marry,

lines.cyr: тој што се сакет, да се земит.
lines.lat: toj što se saket, da se zemit.
lines.en: those who love each other, let them marry.
